# nxos_eem (Data Source)

This data source can read the Embedded Event Manager (EEM) configuration on NX-OS devices, including environment variables and applets with their event specifications, event correlation and actions.

## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `applets` (Attributes Map) List of event manager applets.
  - Map key: `name` - Name of the policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applets))
- `environment_variables` (Attributes Map) List of event manager environment variables.
  - Map key: `name` - Name of the environment variable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environment_variables))
- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.
